verdict.rationale: Wise documents a broad first-party API surface covering many things a user does in the UI: business payments, multi-currency balances and conversion, batch transfers, statements in many formats, card ordering and spend controls, disputes, support cases, recipients and webhooks. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and some flows are delivered as Wise-hosted Embedded Flows rather than plain API calls. The main platform API also has no public OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: explicit UI/API parity statement or coverage map, evidence that account settings/admin/team management are API-accessible, independent hands-on corroboration of parity, public machine-readable spec for the main API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
